_comment: Workbook exercise air-sat-reset (docs/workbook/air-sat-reset.md), lbnl-sdahu part: the supply-air temperature rules only. `camber datasets config lbnl-sdahu --exercise air-sat-reset --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. supply_air_reset asks the shape question (does the trended setpoint SA_TEMPSPT move with OAT, and does supply air fall as OAT rises?); supply_air_reset_compliance compares the supply air with the ASHRAE Guideline 36 OAT-based reset target at its defaults (55 F at 70 F OAT and above, 65 F at 60 F and below), since this unit's sequence documents no reset of its own; supply_air_control asks whether the unit meets the setpoint it has. All three judge fan-on samples (the derived SF_ON) in the simulation's own occupied mode (SYS_CTL) only: the reset rules through their occupied gate, supply_air_control through its occupancy_gate (default "trended" since 0.98; set it to "off" to count the unoccupied fan cycling too, as before 0.98). No parameter is tuned: the unit's fixed 55.25 F setpoint is read from the data, not configured.
